value.rationale: The all-nonzero support condition defines a basis-invariant and large-field-dense natural family whose support graphs are complete, yet the actual evolution-algebra automorphism group is generically trivial. The exact coefficient and exponential field-size rarity, with conditional complete group classification, quantify graph-versus-algebra symmetry and give useful information beyond a structural monomial characterization or isomorphism-class first moment.
